text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Ines! I've been
prepping for
today, so you just go back
to the dorm and get
ready to party!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We've got snacks, cake, and even...
something
that starts with a P!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Ryan, you didn't, did you? Anything
but that!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I got you a present for your
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...Thank goodness! I was afraid she was
going to
say protein powder!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's a set of all my favorite strength
training
equipment! Let's feel the burn
together!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I knew it! I bet she has some protein
powder
stashed away somewhere too!)
